column1: (vii) where any lessee has acquired any asset used
by  him  in  any  trade,  business,  profession  or
vocation,  upon  the  termination  of  a  lease
agreement,  such  acquisition  shall  not  be
considered  as  an  acquisition  which  qualifies
for  any  depreciation  allowance  under  this
section, and such asset shall be treated as an
asset on which depreciation has been granted
to such lessee to the extent of the repayment of
the capital value of such asset under such lease
